Compendium.Name: Core Rulebook
Compendium.Description: The primary rules and definitions for the campaign system.

Abilities.Name: Dexterity
Abilities.Description: Character's overall agility, reflexes, and balance

Abilities.Name: Constitution
Abilities.Description: Character's health, stamina, and vital force

Abilities.Name: Intelligence
Abilities.Description: Character's mental acuity, memory, and analytical skill

Abilities.Name: Wisdom
Abilities.Description: Character's intuition, perception, and spiritual awareness

Abilities.Name: Charisma
Abilities.Description: Character's force of personality, persuasiveness, and leadership

Skills.Name: Athletics
Skills.Description: Character's proficiency in performing athletic tasks, such as climbing, jumping, or swimming.

Skills.Name: Acrobatics
Skills.Description: Character's ability to stay on their feet in tricky situations or perform acrobatic stunts.

Skills.Name: Sleight of Hand
Skills.Description: Manual trickery, such as planting objects, picking pockets, or concealing items.

Skills.Name: Stealth
Skills.Description: Concealing oneself from enemies, slinking away unnoticed, or sneaking up on someone.

Skills.Name: Arcana
Skills.Description: Knowledge about spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, and planes of existence.

Skills.Name: History
Skills.Description: Recall of historical events, legendary figures, ancient kingdoms, and lost civilizations.

Skills.Name: Investigation
Skills.Description: Deducing clues, uncovering hidden structural details, or searching through documents for information.

Skills.Name: Nature
Skills.Description: Recall of lore about terrain, plants and animals, weather, and natural cycles.

Skills.Name: Religion
Skills.Description: Recall of lore about deities, rites, holy symbols, secret cults, and religious practices.

Skills.Name: Animal Handling
Skills.Description: Calming down domesticated animals, keeping a mount from getting spooked, or intuiting animal intent.

Skills.Name: Insight
Skills.Description: Determining the true intentions of a creature, sensing lies, or predicting someone's next move.

Skills.Name: Medicine
Skills.Description: Diagnosing illnesses, stabilizing a dying companion, or treating injuries.

Skills.Name: Perception
Skills.Description: Spotting, hearing, or sensing the presence of something hidden or obscure.

Skills.Name: Survival
Skills.Description: Following tracks, hunting wild game, guiding a group through frozen wastes, and avoiding natural hazards.

Skills.Name: Deception
Skills.Description: Determining whether you can convincingly hide the truth through speech, action, or disguise.

Skills.Name: Intimidation
Skills.Description: Influencing someone through overt threats, hostile actions, or physical force.

Skills.Name: Performance
Skills.Description: Delighting an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling, or other entertainment.

Skills.Name: Persuasion
Skills.Description: Influencing someone with tact, social grace, good nature, or diplomatic conversation.

DamageTypes.Name: Slashing
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by sharp edges, such as swords, axes, and claws.

DamageTypes.Name: Piercing
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by punctures and impalement, such as spears, arrows, and fangs.

DamageTypes.Name: Bludgeoning
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by blunt force impacts, such as hammers, falls, and constrictions.

DamageTypes.Name: Fire
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by burning flames, molten rock, and extreme heat sources.

DamageTypes.Name: Cold
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by freezing temperatures, ice, and magical frost.

DamageTypes.Name: Lightning
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by electrical arcs, static discharges, and lightning bolts.

DamageTypes.Name: Acid
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by corrosive chemical substances and acidic secretions.

DamageTypes.Name: Poison
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by venoms, toxins, and biological poisons.

DamageTypes.Name: Necrotic
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by decaying energy, undeath, and soul-withering magic.

DamageTypes.Name: Radiant
DamageTypes.Description: Damage dealt by searing celestial light, holy energy, and focused positive force.
